newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-THIRD ROUND SCORES AT MERCEDES CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-THIRD ROUND SCORES AT MERCEDES CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Scores after the third round of the PGA Tour's season-opening $1.2 million Mercedes Championships Saturday (U.S. unless noted):
210 John Cook 70 71 69, Corey Pavin 70 68 72, Jim Furyk 67 68 75
211 Scott McCarron 70 72 69, Fred Funk 73 69 69, Phil Mickelson 71 68 72
212 Mark O'Meara 71 72 69, Ernie Els (South Africa) 72 70 70, Tom Watson 70 68 74
213 Michael Bradley 71 74 68, Tim Herron 73 72 68, Clarence Rose 71 71 71, Mark Brooks 72 70 71, Craig Stadler 71 70 72
215 Loren Roberts 71 73 71, Scott Hoch 75 69 71, Ed Fiori 71 71 73
